- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1878-1889 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry block replaces the original BLOCKED answer with any exit-0, non-whitespace retry output and logs `outcome=resolved` whenever that output has no unfenced BLOCKED: line, without checking that it holds a valid `STATUS:` line or BLOCKED: line.
  WHY: The "Parse Codex output" step (lines 2007-2039) then sets `blocked=false` and `needs_clarification=false`, so "Handle blocked clarification output" (line 2041/2042, gated on `blocked == 'true'`) never runs; the issue takes the clear path instead of getting `ai:blocked`, and the original BLOCKED reason is lost. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:150-185 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In path_tokens() (line 153, `if token not in bare and len(bare) < MAX_TOKENS: bare.append(token)`), the 20-entry cap on bare tokens is applied before the tokens are compared with the tracked set, so extensionless prose words fill the cap.
  WHY: An extensionless tracked root file (Makefile/Dockerfile/LICENSE) cited after 20 or more distinct prose words never enters `bare`, check() logs `outcome=skip reason=no_tracked_path`, and the issue goes to `ai:blocked`. The `[:max(0, room)]` slice in check() (lines 184-185) already enforces the cap after filtering, so dropping `and len(bare) < MAX_TOKENS` fixes it. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:101-105 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The bare-token list of extensionless tracked files such as Makefile is capped at 20 tokens before it is filtered against the tracked set.
  WHY: This is the same root cause as the 150-185 entry, kept separate because the reviewer cited lines 101-105 (path_tokens function), which do not overlap the 150-185 citations. A reason with 20 distinct prose words before a tracked file leads to `no_tracked_path`, and the retry is skipped. Rated NIT (mapped to low).
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:101-105 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `sensitive()` applies the snapshot pass-2 credential rules (`pass2_credential_names`/`pass2_secret_name`) to every candidate path, but scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh (line 191; 180-191/187-192) applies them only to `extra` files.
  WHY: A tracked file that is in the snapshot, such as `scripts/db-credentials.yaml` (legacy root `scripts/`, allowed `.yaml` suffix), is dropped from the retry check, so a BLOCKED answer citing it gets `no_tracked_path` and goes to `ai:blocked`. All flaggers rated it NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 assessed it but did not raise it, calling it intentional, documented, and fail-closed.
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:154 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-files` subprocess call has no timeout.
  WHY: An unresponsive filesystem or abnormal repo state hangs the retry path until the overall workflow timeout. Rated NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 (line 181) and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as hardening suggestions (add `timeout=120`).

- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:lines 1878-1888 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Any non-empty exit-0 retry output replaces the known BLOCKED answer, even with no `STATUS:` line and no BLOCKED: line, and the step logs `outcome=resolved`.

Suggested fix: accept the output only when it matches `^\s*(\*\*)?STATUS:` or has an unfenced BLOCKED: line; otherwise restore `${clarify_bv_original}` and log `outcome=failed`.
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:line 153 path_tokens(); line 184 check() | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The 20-entry bare-token cap is applied before comparison with the tracked set, so prose words consume the cap; this contradicts the comment at lines 151-152.
  WHY: An extensionless tracked root file (Makefile/Dockerfile/LICENSE) cited after 20 or more prose words is never collected, giving `outcome=skip reason=no_tracked_path` and `ai:blocked`. Fix: drop `and len(bare) < MAX_TOKENS`.
- NOTE (assessed, not raised): the pass-2 credential filter applies to every path (scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh lines 101-105) vs scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh line 191 (extra only); judged intentional, documented, and fail-closed. The git ls-files call without a timeout is bounded by the step timeout.
- HARDENING (3 related items): line 153 drop `and len(bare) < MAX_TOKENS`; clarify.yml line 1878 add a STATUS:/BLOCKED: grep to the acceptance condition; check() `subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "-z"], ...)` add `timeout=120`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

  WHY: Example reason `BLOCKED: The issue asks the runtime to change release target because the Makefile is not present` gives `outcome=skip reason=no_tracked_path` and `ai:blocked`. Fix: drop the `len(bare) < MAX_TOKENS` guard.

  WHY: `pass2_secret_name` makes `keep` return False, the candidate is filtered out at line 160-161, and `log("skip", "no_tracked_path")` runs. The mirror test pins this behaviour and must change too. Fix: apply pass-2 rules only to paths that are not legacy-eligible.
